title: Volume of Fluid (OpenFOAM)
description: **Incompressible Volume-of-Fluid** participant (interFoam / incompressibleVoF) for a **coupled SME ↔ VOF** run. The shallow-moment side is the *moment participant* (the Coupled solver in the Solver tab); this card is the *VOF participant*. It is not configurable here beyond the shared mesh — the two are coupled at run time over preCICE. Needs a connected **foam** (OpenFOAM + preCICE) backend.

title: Compressible VOF (OpenFOAM)
description: **Compressible Volume-of-Fluid** participant (compressibleInterFoam / compressibleVoF) for a coupled SME ↔ VOF run with a compressible gas phase. Pairs with the Coupled solver as the VOF participant; coupled over preCICE. Needs a connected **foam** backend.
